name: core.openwop.workflows.lighthouse
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0149 / ADR 0155 follow-on). The five zero-config 'lighthouse' workflows from the ADR 0149 catalog — Lead Triage, Account Brief, Renewal & Churn-Risk Digest, RFP Response, and Post-Meeting Follow-up — authored entirely over node typeIds shipped with this host (feature.crm/kb/analytics + core.ai.chatCompletion + core.chat.approvalGate + core.openwop.integration.*). Each rides real tenant data through the feature node packs, reasons with the LLM node, gates every external send behind a human approval, and delivers a usable artifact. Tenant-specific values are RUN PARAMETERS (never hardcoded) so the expansion stays replay-deterministic. Picking one in the builder instantiates a fully-editable, runnable, assignable workflow.
author: openwop
